name: field-wrapper
title: Field Wrapper
description: Opinionated field wrappers combining Field layout, label, and error display for Input, Textarea, Radio, Checkbox, Switch, Select, DatePicker, Combobox, Autocomplete, NumberField, Slider, OTP, and InputGroup.

files.content:
type allowedPrimitiveT = string | number | boolean

type optionT = {
  label: React.ReactNode
  value: allowedPrimitiveT
  className?: string
  disabled?: boolean
}

type groupT = {
  group: string
  options: (allowedPrimitiveT | optionT)[]
  className?: string
}

type optionsT = (allowedPrimitiveT | optionT | groupT)[]

type indicatorAtT = 'right' | 'left'
